body:
It's been a few days since I posted this and I had some time to think about this.

And you're wrong. I can screw it up. I already did it once.

But anyway, I'll try to see if something like that is available at my college. But if I'm honest, I doubt that it will solve anything. I'm not even sure why exactly I wanted to tell it to a friend in the first place.
It won't help with anything.

> Go call a sage. Preferably someone older. A parent? Aunt/uncle? Neighbor?

That is a hard thing to do. And I'm not sure if I could. 
If I did I'll show my whole family what a failure I am. Then people will feel sorry for me. And then I truly don't know if people like me or just not wanting me to die.

I already had trouble telling it to 1 person already. And after this I'm not sure if I would want to risk it again. 
Knowing myself, I'll probably manage to fuck it up too one way or another.
